name: Buon Ma Thuot
provinceNote: From 1 July 2025 Phu Yen and Dak Lak are one province, and the administrative center is Buon Ma Thuot. The coast is in the same province on paper. The city is still a highland coffee town, not a beach stop.
dotReason: Worth a special trip in this corridor
summary: October 10 Square is the roundabout in the middle of town: a tank under a white arch, and motorbikes on the ring. Stay for robusta country and red-bowl bun do. Choose Nha Trang or Da Lat when the beach or the pine hills are the trip.
fee: No single city ticket. Museums, the coffee museum, and the waterfalls each charge their own.
getThere: Buon Ma Thuot Airport (BMV). About 60 minutes from Ho Chi Minh City
seoTitle: Buon Ma Thuot travel guide — square, coffee, bun do
seoDescription: October 10 Square holds a tank under a white arch. The flight from Ho Chi Minh City is about 60 minutes. Bun do on Le Hong Phong starts about 15:00.
intro: October 10 Square, Quảng trường 10 tháng 3, is the roundabout in the middle of Buon Ma Thuot: a tank under a white arch, a statue on the column, motorbikes on the ring. You came for the coffee plateau. A phin in the morning, the museums on Y Ngong, and red-bowl bun do on Le Hong Phong once the stalls open. Stay when that highland day is the trip. Choose Nha Trang or Da Lat when the beach or the pine hills are the reason.

The half-day south of town is Dray Nur, a curtain about 250 m wide on the Serepok. The Dak Lak Department of Culture, Sports and Tourism handbook puts it about 30 km from the city. A news article from the Dak Lak culture and tourism center puts it about 25 km. The drive minutes are Check on arrival. The handbook prints 30,000 VND to enter and 50,000 VND for a combo with Gia Long. The news article cites 50,000 VND. The Department of Justice fee schedule prints 30,000 VND as the adult default for a scenic site. A notice from the culture and tourism center, dated 19 Dec 2024, announces a new price and does not print the amount. The gate price is Check on arrival. Swim only where staff allow it.

Dak Lak Museum and Bao Dai Palace share 02 Y Ngong. The museum is three floors of ethnology, history, and natural history, plus a longhouse model outside. The provincial fee schedule prints 30,000 VND for an adult and 20,000 VND for a child. Hours are Check on arrival. The palace is the 1926 villa, a French-era residence later used by Bao Dai. It is a monument, not a hotel. Allow 45 to 60 minutes. Its ticket is Check on arrival. The World Coffee Museum stands on Nguyen Dinh Chieu in Tan Loi. The museum's ticket list prints 7:00–18:00. The museum's FAQ prints 8:00–17:00, Monday to Sunday. An adult is 150,000 VND. A child from 7 to 12 is 40,000 VND. Show tickets are separate, and that price is Check on arrival. Trung Nguyen Coffee Village is a different campus. Its ticket is Check on arrival.

Khải Đoan pagoda is in the Phan Boi Chau area. Give it 30 to 45 minutes in the late afternoon. A donation may be asked. The amount is Check on arrival. The prison at 18 Tan Thuat, in Tu An, is the French-built compound kept as a heritage site. Allow 45 minutes. Its ticket is Check on arrival. Bun do is the afternoon bowl on Le Hong Phong: thick red noodles in a pork-and-crab broth, with shrimp paste on the side. Vietnam National Administration of Tourism puts the stalls from about 15:00 or 16:00. The close is Check on arrival. An older bowl band on that article, 15,000–30,000 VND, is not a price to count on. The price now is Check on arrival.

Ako Dhong, on the north edge, is the quiet evening: Ede longhouses and garden cafes. Walking through is free. A cup is Check on arrival. Yok Don’s walk watches retired elephants and does not include a ride. The park operator prints a half day at 08:00–11:00 or 13:30–16:30, at 850,000 VND for the first adult and 650,000 VND for each extra guest, plus park entrance of 60,000 VND for an adult, 20,000 VND for a Vietnamese student, and 10,000 VND for a child. Full-day prices from the park operator do not match one another. Confirm them when you book, and book ahead. The park is about 40 km west. Lak Lake is about 45 km east, for a dugout at sunset. Buon Jun prints 80,000 VND for 30 minutes. The Lak tourism area prints 150,000 VND for two guests for 30 minutes. Minutes for both drives are Check on arrival. In a festival year the main stage is back on October 10 Square.
gettingAround: Buon Ma Thuot Airport (BMV) is in Hamlet 3, Hoa Thang Commune. Airports Corporation of Vietnam operates it. The Dak Lak handbook prints a flight from Ho Chi Minh City of about 60 minutes, and from Hanoi of about 1 hour 45 minutes. The city is about 350 km from Ho Chi Minh City and about 1,400 km from Hanoi. The handbook bus runs about 8 hours and about 200,000–400,000 VND. Those road figures are approximate. Da Nang has flights. The duration and the fare are Check on arrival. The road to Da Lat is there. The minutes and the fare are Check on arrival. There is no passenger rail into town. A Tuy Hoa–Buon Ma Thuot line is named in provincial planning and has no timetable. Taxi minutes from the airport are Check on arrival.

Grab and taxis cover town. The coffee museum, Khải Đoan, the prison, and Y Ngong sit in the city. Dray Nur, Lak Lake, Yok Don, and Ea Kao need a car or a tour. Ea Kao is the nearer lake, south of town. Its fee is Check on arrival. Do not mix it up with Lak. Rain can slow the hill roads. A closure list for the airport road is Check on arrival.

stayAreas.name: City center
stayAreas.summary: Hotels around Nguyen Tat Thanh and Le Duan keep October 10 Square, Y Ngong, Khải Đoan, and the bun do streets a short ride away.

eat: Bún đỏ on Le Hong Phong from about 15:00 or 16:00, bánh ướt chồng đĩa on Trần Nhật Duật or Lê Thánh Tông, and cơm lam with grilled chicken and rượu cần. Published prices do not match. The price now is Check on arrival.
interestsBody: Coffee is a phin in the morning, the World Coffee Museum on Nguyen Dinh Chieu, and Trung Nguyen Coffee Village on a separate ticket.
October 10 Square is the festival stage. Khải Đoan pagoda is the large hall in the Phan Boi Chau area.
Waterfalls and lakes are Dray Nur on the Serepok, then Lak Lake at sunset and Ea Kao closer to town.
Museums and the prison are the Y Ngong campus and the compound at 18 Tan Thuat.
Ako Dhong is the longhouse walk on the north edge. Yok Don is the elephant walk about 40 km west, without a ride.

interestGroups.title: Dining and F&B
interestGroups.summary: Bún đỏ on Le Hong Phong, bánh ướt chồng đĩa, and cơm lam with the jar. A current price is Check on arrival.
body: Vietnam National Administration of Tourism puts bún đỏ on Le Hong Phong from about 15:00 or 16:00. VnExpress puts bánh ướt chồng đĩa on Trần Nhật Duật and Lê Thánh Tông. Bao Dak Lak puts the bamboo rice, the grilled yard chicken, and the jar at Ko Tam and at Buon Tri A in Buon Don.

The published bún đỏ prices do not match: 15,000–30,000 VND, 20,000–35,000 VND, and 20,000–30,000 VND. The price now is Check on arrival. Bitter eggplant, canh thụt, and the forest greens are the other Êđê plates.

interestGroups.title: Pagodas and the square
interestGroups.summary: Khải Đoan is the large pagoda in town. October 10 Square is the festival stage.
body: October 10 Square, Quảng trường 10 tháng 3, is the open plaza in the center. Walking it is free. Ordinary evenings are quiet. In a festival year the coffee festival puts the main stage here. The Dak Lak provincial government records the ninth edition as 9–13 March 2025, with the opening at 20:00 on 10 March and the closing at 20:00 on 13 March. The provincial government says the festival is held every two years. The 2027 dates are Check on arrival. The Coffee Festival 2025 program puts a street parade at the Ngã Sáu monument at 15:30 on 10 March 2025. A single visitor pass is Check on arrival.
Khải Đoan sits in the Phan Boi Chau area. Allow 30 to 45 minutes. Late afternoon puts softer light on the roof. A donation may be asked. The amount is Check on arrival.

cards.title: Khai Doan Pagoda
cards.summary: The large pagoda in the Phan Boi Chau area. Allow 30 to 45 minutes. A donation amount is Check on arrival.

interestGroups.title: Waterfalls and lakes
interestGroups.summary: Dray Nur is the half-day on the Serepok. Lak Lake and Ea Kao are the other water.
body: Dray Nur is a curtain about 250 m wide. The Dak Lak handbook puts it about 30 km south. A culture and tourism center news article puts it about 25 km. Allow a half day with the drive. The minutes are Check on arrival. The handbook prints 30,000 VND to enter and 50,000 VND for a combo with Gia Long. The news article cites 50,000 VND. The Department of Justice schedule prints 30,000 VND as the adult scenic default. A 19 Dec 2024 notice announces a new price and does not print the amount. The gate price is Check on arrival.

Lak Lake is about 45 km east. Go for sunset. A boat at Buon Jun is 80,000 VND for 30 minutes. The Lak tourism area prints 150,000 VND for two guests for 30 minutes. Village fees are Check on arrival. It is a freshwater lake. Ea Kao is the nearer lake south of the city. The fee is Check on arrival.

cards.title: Dray Nur
cards.summary: A wide fall on the Serepok, about 25 km or about 30 km south. The gate price is Check on arrival.

interestGroups.title: Museums and the prison
interestGroups.summary: Y Ngong holds the museum and Bao Dai’s villa. The old prison is on Tan Thuat.
body: Dak Lak Museum is at 02 Y Ngong. Plan on one to two hours, and go on a weekday morning if you want fewer school groups. The provincial fee schedule prints 30,000 VND for an adult and 20,000 VND for a child. Hours are Check on arrival. Walk out to the longhouse model behind the building.

Bao Dai Palace is the 1926 villa at the same address. It is a monument, not a hotel. Allow 45 to 60 minutes. The ticket is Check on arrival. The prison at 18 Tan Thuat, Tu An, is the French-built compound kept as a heritage site. Allow 45 minutes. Its ticket is Check on arrival.

cards.title: Buon Ma Thuot Prison
cards.summary: The French-built compound at 18 Tan Thuat. Allow 45 minutes. The ticket is Check on arrival.

season.label: November to April
season.note: These are the drier months for the plateau. Rain can slow the hill roads. A closure list for the airport road is Check on arrival. In a festival year the coffee festival is in March, on October 10 Square. The ninth edition ran 9–13 March 2025. The Dak Lak provincial government says it is held every two years. The 2027 dates are Check on arrival.

faqs.a: Downtown, around Nguyen Tat Thanh and Le Duan, near Y Ngong and the afternoon bun do streets. Lak Lake and Yok Don are day trips, not the usual hotel address.

Vietnam National Administration of Tourism puts the Le Hong Phong stalls from about 15:00 or 16:00. Noon is too early. The close and the current bowl price are Check on arrival. An older band of 15,000–30,000 VND on that article is not a price to count on.

The ninth edition ran 9–13 March 2025. The opening was 20:00 on 10 March and the closing was 20:00 on 13 March, both at October 10 Square, Quảng trường 10 tháng 3. A street parade left the Ngã Sáu monument at 15:30 on 10 March 2025. The Dak Lak provincial government says the festival is held every two years. The 2027 dates are Check on arrival. A visitor pass is Check on arrival. The program also lists an elephant fair at Buon Don during that week. Ordinary-year dates for the fair are Check on arrival.

faqs.q: Is this a beach trip after the Phu Yen merger?
faqs.a: From 1 July 2025 Phu Yen and Dak Lak are one province, and the administrative center is Buon Ma Thuot. The city is still the highland coffee town. The coast is a separate ride. Nha Trang is its own trip.
Fly into BMV. The Dak Lak handbook prints about 60 minutes from Ho Chi Minh City and about 1 hour 45 minutes from Hanoi. Taxi minutes into town are Check on arrival. There is no passenger train.
